about_the_game:
Blanksword is a Roguelike RPG with strategic turn-based battles, a rich layered story, and a one of a kind brain management system. Enter a land full of dangers as BLANK, an amnesiac wandering Angel, and come to the aid of those that were wronged by God’s cruel law.

SOLVE YOUR MURDER

You have no memories, except for one: a single eye and a cruel smile as you got stabbed in the dark. You left your home looking for answers and you won’t stop until you get back at the Angel that betrayed and left you for dead.

TURN GOD'S LAND UPSIDE DOWN

God’s country is in chaos: dangerous and bizarre creatures, such as talking mushrooms and landlords, roam the land and the dead rise back to life under an eternal daylight. Will you cut your enemies down, burn them to a crisp, poison them or strike terror into their hearts with the power of philosophy? With hundreds of skills and items to choose from, His country is your oyster!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR BRAIN

Find brain parts on your travels and rebuild yourself from scratch. Each brain part allows you to experience the world in a different way, but you can only equip a few of them per run. Will you play as a gourmet that cooks his way to victory, a charming people-pleaser, or a scholar of the occult?

FIGHT, DIE, LEARN, RINSE, REPEAT

Your enemies always return from the dead? Well, so do you! Use the spoils of war between runs to raise your strength permanently and grow your knowledge of Blanksword’s expansive turn-based mechanics and overworld challenges to propel yourself to victory.

MAKE FRIENDS AND FIND LOVE

Form lasting and dynamic relationships with denizens of God’s country that share your revolutionary tendencies. Meet hot criminals in your area and get intrusive phone calls from a weirdo (flirting optional).

FEATURES

  • Experiment with 15+ Brain Parts with game-changing properties

  • Explore various regions such as a mushroom forest, a sprawling radio tower or moldy apartments

  • Fight against a large panel of enemies, each with unique attacks and behaviors

  • Customize your loadout each run with 150+ attacks & skills that can fit into any playstyle

  • Get to know a rich cast of well-fleshed out characters

  • Beat challenges ranging from precise platforming to fight arenas and races against the clock

  • Strengthen yourself between runs with permanent upgrades

  • Line your pockets as you complete tasks… but not too much: in Blanksword, money is a curse!

PLAY THE FREE DEMO NOW

  • Play through a generous portion of Blanksword's early game,

  • Discover Blanksword's story & characters,

  • Try out multiple Brain Parts & Movesets and face the challenges of the Finite Forest, the Complex Apartments & the Field of Forget-Me-Nots,

  • Your progress in the Demo will carry over to the full game when it releases

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains swearing, cartoon violence, blood, visually abstracted gore (plants standing in for organs), and disturbing themes like self-harm.

short_description: You’re a fallen Angel, your brain is missing and half of God’s country wants you dead (again!). Battle legions of weird monsters with your smiling sword. Find and customize a large number of skills. Rebuild your brain from scratch and rise against a tyrannical God in this turn-based roguelike RPG!
